name: fix_python_unsafe_pickle_load
description: Fixes unsafe deserialization: pickle.loads on an untrusted session blob executes arbitrary code
prompts: SessionStore.decode in session_store.py restores a session blob (bytes) back into a dict. It calls pickle.loads on the untrusted blob, and unpickling executes code embedded in the payload (via __reduce__) - a remote code execution foothold. The session format is now JSON: blobs are produced with json.dumps(...).encode('utf-8'). Rewrite decode to parse the blob as JSON (json.loads) and return the resulting dict, so an untrusted blob can never execute code. Do NOT keep a pickle fallback. A legitimate JSON blob must still decode to the same dict. Keep the class name and the decode(self, blob) signature; the module already imports json.
